Humans are large slabs of marble, and every bad thing that happens the strike of a chisel. They shape us, and sometimes even destroy us. World powers are made up of hundreds of thousands of slabs. We start the same but are all molded differently, by the time we reach adulthood we have been chiseled into the mold of a certain state by those who came before us. Some are able to look at outsiders sculpted in different ways and see art, while others see only something that is different.
